correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact Z-chain presentation of regular path H1: commutation of (1,s) and (s,1) eliminates vertex-labelled edges, and triangle/pair collisions exhaust Ω2. The six displayed internal pair-sum relations reduce integrally to a,b,z with 2z=0, and all r blocks contribute direct summands plus one winding class. Program verifies exact relation lists for r=1..5 and Smith minors of the eight-point block; finite checks supplement, rather than substitute for, the all-r algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Constructs strongly connected vertex-transitive directed graphs with arbitrary 2-torsion rank in degree-one integral regular path homology and identifies all free and torsion summands for infinitely many moduli. The phenomenon cannot be read from rational Betti numbers and is a nontrivial structural realization, not a tabular extension; large degree and modulus remain stated limitations.
